motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Ruzzin to approve consent items 3A through 3L with items 3-C, 3-H and 3-L removed.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to approve consent items 3A through 3K with items 3C, 3H and 3L removed. The motion carried 9:0.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Havlick to direct the City Manager to identify a public process and implement a public forum where the public can express its best ideas for where and how much C.U. should expand and then following the pubic forum reconvene negotiations between the City and C.U.
motions.vote_text: A motion to direct the City Manager to conduct a public forum to solicit public input as to possible alternate development sites for C.U., to happen concurrently with discussions between the City and C.U. The motion carried 8:1; Eldridge opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to approve the recommendations from the Integrated Pest Management Task Force.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to approve the recommendations from the Integrated Pest Management Task Force. The motion carried 9:0.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Ruzzin to suspend the rules and continue the meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:4; Corson, Eldridge, Havlick and Riggle opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Riggle to approve, as City Council, items related to 9th and Canyon.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Eldridge recused.

motions.motion_text: Board Member Mock moved, seconded by Riggle to approve, as the Central Area General Improvement District Board of Directors, items related to 9th and Canyon.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Eldridge recused.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel to suspend the rules and continue the meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Eldridge recused.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Riggle to postpone the the findings of fact in order to commission an independent expert(s) to examine the property and to return to Council to provide testimony regarding the reports(s) with the opportunity for cross examination by the applicant.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 6:3, Corson, Havlick and Ruzzin opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7279 amending Title 9, “Land Use Regulation,” B.R.C. 1981, by amending standards related to the landscaping.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7280 designating the structure and its site located at 1625 Pine, also known as the Chauncey Stokes House, as an individual landmark under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7281 amending Ordinance No. 7203 (2002) designating the structure and a portion of its site located at 4789 28th Street, also known as the Holiday Drive-In Marquee, as an individual landmark under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7282 amending Title 4, B.R.C., 1981 creating a system of publicly installed news boxes on three corners within the Downtown Boulder Business Improvement District.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7283 amending Chapter 4-11, B.R.C., 1981 making changes to the Pearl Street Mall permitting system and amending the Mall zone maps.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7284 amending section 9-6-2 Growth Management, definition of “Mixed Use Development,” adding Residential Main Street (RMS-X) zones to the list of exempt mixed use zones.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7285 approving and authorizing the issuance of Boulder Municipal Property Authority Lease Purchase Revenue Note, Series 2003A, in the aggregate principal amount of $715,000, and approving and authorizing a Lease Purchase Agreement for the purchase of 57.4 acres of land together with 1 - 1/8 shares of the Original Cottonwood Ditch and 1/4 mineral rights located at 2500 75th Street from Helayne B. Jones for Open Space and Mountain Parks purposes.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7286 amending Chapter 2-7, B.R.C. 1981, expanding the scope of regulations regarding standards of conduct and ethics for City Councilmembers, members of City boards, commissions, or task forces and City employees.

open_comment_speakers.name: Randall Weiner
open_comment_speakers.topic: IPM Task Force and EAB member - did not support lifting the 50' moratorium on use of pesticide near water.

open_comment_speakers.name: Randy Bradford Heap
open_comment_speakers.topic: representing Chautauqua Dining Hall requesting support for item 3J (Ordinance No. 7276) allowing an optional premise type license.

open_comment_speakers.name: Andrew Jarmon
open_comment_speakers.topic: re: non-potable water usage on sports fields in Boulder - urged Boulder to be more proactive in this area.

open_comment_speakers.name: Mary Chavers
open_comment_speakers.topic: Pesticide sensitive individual concerned about possibility of no notice of pesticide spraying.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ruth Blackmore
open_comment_speakers.topic: re: CU South, indicated that annexation was previously prohibited until after the Hydrology study is complete - now it seems that has changed. Asked that no more secret meetings take place re: CU South property.

open_comment_speakers.name: Morten Hempel
open_comment_speakers.topic: re: equity to low income citizens. Diversity must be present in its representation.

open_comment_speakers.name: Jerry Wyss
open_comment_speakers.topic: inviting Council to the 8th Annual Martin Acres Home Tour on Sunday, May 18th, featuring remodeled 1950's homes.

open_comment_speakers.name: Michael Banks
open_comment_speakers.topic: re: landlord security deposit. Suggested revisiting the 5.5% interest requirement on security deposits.

open_comment_speakers.name: Bill Taggart
open_comment_speakers.topic: re: water restrictions - asked for clarification re: sod or newly seeded. Urged Council to reconsider.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rich Lopez
open_comment_speakers.topic: representing Jon Telleen, applicant for 429 Spruce St. Indicated that Mr. Telleen is willing to continue the hearing on 429 Spruce Street until another engineer's independent assessment. Urged Council to remove from consent and re-open the hearing.

open_comment_speakers.name: Chuck Howe
open_comment_speakers.topic: supported adoption of Ordinance No. 7270 as an interim measure but not long term.

open_comment_speakers.name: Joshua Allen Ruschhaupt
open_comment_speakers.topic: CU Environmental Studies student urged Council to adopt a bio diesel policy for the city.

open_comment_speakers.name: Calvin Berry
open_comment_speakers.topic: Fairview student expressing signage concerns at flashing light pedestrian crossings.

open_comment_speakers.name: Robert Sharpe
open_comment_speakers.topic: re: 1) support for neighborhood schools; 2) urged finding viable candidates for November election; and 3) provided a report card on Council's "Fair Process."

open_comment_speakers.name: Stephen Keenan
open_comment_speakers.topic: thanked Council for its continued support for neighborhood schools and for its presence at the recent BVSD meeting on school closures.

open_comment_speakers.name: Kerrie Badertscher
open_comment_speakers.topic: IPM Task Force member in support of the recommendations.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ruth Wright
open_comment_speakers.topic: CU South Campus Committee member - indicated that the goal is to keep this property open. Opposed to the motion re: CU South.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ben Binder
open_comment_speakers.topic: indicated that the 130 acres being discussed is not developable, raised concerns re:location of the detention ponds and asked that as the city proceeds not to give away the baby. Nothing worth while can happen until the Hydrology study is completed.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lynn Segal
open_comment_speakers.topic: supports the idea of a public forum and encouraged the Council to listen to the community. The whole process should be open to the public.

open_comment_speakers.name: Anne Vickery
open_comment_speakers.topic: Village Arts Coalition, partners in the Civic Use - noted that the development of the lease for the civic use was not yet complete and that although progress had been made, was disturbed that until just a few days prior to the meeting, they were unaware that the approval for the rest of the project was scheduled for this meeting.
